data.name: Madha
data.gender_notes: Madha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘madhushree’ meaning ‘intelligent’, ‘graceful’, ‘beautiful’ and ‘fortunate’. In Hindu mythology, Madha is the name of a goddess associated with love, compassion, and wisdom. The name Madha carries the meaning “Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil. Parents who choose Madha usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that represents the divine feminine energy of intelligence, grace, and good fortune. It is believed to bring blessings of wisdom, love, and prosperity.
data.etymology: Madha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Madha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
